items.item_text: Bachelor's degree in related field from an accredited institution.

Plans and manages visits from educators, professionals, administrators and other assigned student affiliated professionals to the university. Plans visits to schools, schedules and makes presentations, interviews, and follow-up visits.

Identifies potential students, and provides information about higher education generally and UC specifically. Specializes in targeted recruitment including but not limited to high achievers, majors, regions, unrepresented populations and other groups identified by the director

Provides in-depth information on admissions requirements, prerequisite courses, school/college programs and curricula, specific financial aid criteria, and career opportunities in person, online and via webinars

Evaluates transcripts and international records for eligibility. Screens applicants for school/college/department faculty. Using extensive knowledge of college/school/department requirements and applicant pool, assesses the applicants' overall record and experience for final admissions determination and recommendation. Assesses applicants for motivation, initiative, leadership potential, work/life experience, extracurricular activities, socioeconomic status, disability, and educational/personal hardship
Assist in coordinating and participating in on and off-campus student recruitment, yeild events and campaigns
Uses enrollment management tools to research, develop strategies for recruitment- yield of students. Prepares reports and provides recommendations for new recruitment initiatives.
Licenses and Certifications
Valid US Drivers License.
Minimum 3 years experience in directly related field.
Knowledge, Skills and Abilities
Thorough knowledge and experience working with a diverse student population. Preferred
High level of organizational and self-starting skills. Preferred

Thorough and comprehensive knowledge of academic programs, including curricula, admissions requirements, and financial aid programs, at colleges/universities and specifically at UC, and/or specific colleges and schools. Preferred
Ability to establish and maintain cooperative relationships with schools, universities, community organizations, and other institutions. Preferred
Excellent Communication skills, including public speaking and writing.
Knowledgeable of recruitment and outreach tools such as Salesforce, TargetX, and College Board.
Experience in managing a travel schedule.
Experience being a part of a team.
Experience working independently.

This position will be required to complete all pre-employment requirements, including a background investigation, the University's credentialing process, and verification of licensure and/or certification through the appropriate California licensing or certifying board(s), as applicable.
Background check  required.
